title: Twin Tag Categories — taxonomy configuration
description: Schema for the JSON file loaded by `register(webui_categories_config=<path>)`. Categories are the top-level domains (Infrastructure, Network, Compliance, etc.) that tags live under. Source of truth: this file. Twin enforces it on every boot via replace-not-merge semantics.

id.description: Stable machine identifier used by tags to reference this category. Lowercase, no spaces. Tags pointing at a removed id become orphan (logged as warning, never auto-deleted).

label.description: Human-readable display name rendered in the WebUI sidebar 'All domains' and in the tag chips.

color.description: Hex color (e.g. #5A7FB4) used as the chip background and sidebar accent. Pick from the Twin palette or a hue distinct from neighboring categories to avoid colorblind ambiguity.
